name: Inufue Nayu
source:
Nayu is Hitori’s childhood friend who is a year younger than him. She follows Hitori to his new school even though it is quite far away from their home town. She is quite unsociable and doesn’t like talking to people and can reply to people quite icily. Nayu is quite strong and refuses to show her weak points in public, although, behind this tough exterior is really a very shy and sweet girl. She’s scared of people as she used to live in the country and is scared that people will find her very strange. She feels at ease when she’s with the protagonist.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/06/12/preview-yomehapi-you-make-happy/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
